description: This source file provides extension methods for configuring Orleans silo and client builders to use DynamoDB for clustering. It defines multiple overloads of 'UseDynamoDBClustering' for both ISiloBuilder and IClientBuilder, enabling dependency injection setup with DynamoDB-specific options and singleton services.
